title: Tenma Saki — Simmered Gently and Lovingly〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki! Mom just poured us some after-dinner tea!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong? You look concerned.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, don't tell me.
Did you not have enough to eat during dinner? Or would you like some dessert?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? No, I'm not hungry or anything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's just... What we talked about during dinner is kinda bothering me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, the thing about Mom and Dad going over to have dinner with Toya's parents at their house?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. I thought that meant we'd get to go over too, but it's just adults only this time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To be fair, they've known each other for a very long time, so it makes sense that they'd want to have a meal as friends.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But if it's adults only, where does that leave Toya? Wouldn't he sort of have to eat all by himself since it's gonna be a party for just our parents?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Toya might not mind...
But if it were me in his shoes, I'd be pretty against it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Hmmmm...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmmm... Ah, yes, that's it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If our parents are going to have a dinner party with just them, why don't we throw ourselves a dinner party here?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
That's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Isn't it?!
Go on! Shower me with more praise!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Way to go, Tsukasa! You're the best!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You two certainly seem to be enjoying yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Mom! We were just talking about throwing our own dinner party here!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
I see.
Would you like me to relay this to Toya's mother?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really?! You will?!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Of course.
But you need to check with Toya to see if he's free, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! It's already getting late, so we'll ask him about it later!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope your party turns out well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thanks, Mom!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Tsukasa!
What should we have for our dinner party?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, we could have pizza, chicken, sushi, some other dishes... Oh, we could even have a spread of hors d'oeuvres!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! Those all sound so good!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I can't wait♪
Doesn't this remind you of when we were little?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we used to have dinner with Toya quite often whenever he came over to our house.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly. Every time we heard that Toya was coming over, we always asked Mom if we could help! I remember that being so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, Toya enjoyed it as well.
Not only that, but helping prepare our own meal made it feel just that much more special.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, guess what♪
I just thought of something really amazing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. What a coincidence, Saki. So did I.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's say it together on three.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's cook dinner for ourselves!
We should cook something!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You came up with the same idea as me. I should expect no less from my sister.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Same for you, brother.
You thought of the same thing as I did.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's go with that! We're going to put together an incredible feast!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! That means we need to come up with a menu!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. Why don't we start by thinking about what we want to eat?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. What do you think Toya would like? It'd be great if we could come up with a menu that he'll really enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it would!
